entities.summary: Sergei Babenko is an Estonian retired professional basketball player who played mostly at the shooting guard position. His most notable achievement as a member of the Soviet Union national team was the winning of the silver medal in the 1987 EuroBasket competition. He was also a member of KK Kalev, who won the USSR Premier Basketball League in 1991. He was 6th in EuroBasket 1993 with Estonia national team.
